operation.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. List records of any entity, addressed by its `entityKey` (e.g. `client`, `product`, `cost_center`, `work_order`).

This is a generic, metadata-driven endpoint: the columns of each returned record are defined per entity, so the field set differs by `entityKey`. Use the entity schema/fields endpoints to discover an entity's fields.

**Authentication & authorization.** Requires an OAuth2 Bearer token. The caller must hold the entity's **view** permission; otherwise the request is rejected with `401`.

**Response modes.** The `mode` query parameter selects the response shape (default `api`, a paginated list):

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| api | Paginated list (default). |
| paginate | Paginated list. |
| listing | Lightweight id/label list, for dropdowns. |
| count | Returns only `{ "total": <n> }`. |
| export | Export-oriented payload. |
| nav | Navigation (prev/next) payload. |

**Filtering.** Pass nested filters as `filter[<field>][<operator>]=<value>` (operators include `equal`, `like`); group alternatives under `filter[or][<field>][<operator>]=<value>`.

**Field selection.** Pass `fields[]=<column>` (repeatable) to limit the columns returned.

parameters.name: entityKey
parameters.description: The entity key whose records to list, e.g. `client`, `product`, `cost_center`, `work_order`.

parameters.name: dataLevel
parameters.description: Depth of related/nested data to load (higher loads more relations). Optional; defaults to `2` when omitted.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Response shape. Defaults to `api` (paginated). One of `api`, `paginate`, `listing`, `count`, `export`, `nav`.

parameters.name: fields[]
parameters.description: Repeatable. Restrict the returned columns to the listed fields.

parameters.name: filter[<field>][<operator>]
parameters.description: Nested filter, e.g. `filter[business_name][like]=acme`. Operators include `equal` and `like`. Use `filter[or][...]` for OR groups.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Records per page for paginated modes.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field and direction; persisted as the caller's sorting preference for this entity.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: When set to `2`, each row is post-formatted for display (honours `image_size`).

200.description: Success. In the default `api`/`paginate` modes a paginated envelope is returned; `count` mode returns `{ "total": <n> }`. Each record's own columns are at the top level and related data is nested under the relation name (fields are entity-specific).

data.description: The page of records. Each item's fields depend on the entity.

400.description: The entity key is unknown, the entity's plugin is not active, or the list could not be built.

401.description: The caller does not hold the entity's view permission.
